title: RD-01 Each look turns on its own motion set by default
description:
Today the everyday popup shows almost none of the 73 motion exhibits: features are on only through `--motion` or VOXTYPE_OSD_VO_MOTION, and the daemon passes neither. This bead adds per-look default motion sets, so each look runs the effects the redesign gave it.

- New src/bin/osd_vo/defaults.rs with `defaults(theme) -> &'static [&'static str]`, filled from the table in docs/REDESIGN-PLAN.md section 3 (the feature names of each look's four effects). Built-in effects (final pass, hand-off, receipt, palimpsest) need no entry.
- Look::on (voxtype_osd_vo.rs) also answers true for the look's defaults, unless motion is set to `none`.
- Config `[osd] motion`: `"look"` (default: the look's set), `"none"` (no extras, today's behaviour), or a list of feature names that replaces the set. CLI `--motion` and VOXTYPE_OSD_VO_MOTION keep working and win over the config. `no-<name>` entries remove one default.

Files: src/bin/osd_vo/defaults.rs (new), src/bin/voxtype_osd_vo.rs, src/osd/config.rs, docs/CONFIGURATION.md.

Given the swiss look and no motion config, when a dictation runs, then pause-marks, pitch-baseline, audio-ruler and fold-under are on.
Given `[osd] motion = "none"`, when a dictation runs, then no default extras are on.
Given `--motion onset-ink`, then only onset-ink is on (the flag replaces the set).

title: RD-02 Living idle motion: policy, frame pacing and a CPU budget per look
description:
The maintainer wants every look to feel alive with small, subtle animations that keep running while the popup is open. Motion rule 8 (settle to still) and the budget gate (idle frames 0) forbid that today. This bead sets the new rule and the tools to hold it, before any look adds idle motion.

Do:
- Decide the policy with a short Fable consult (consult-oracles skill): idle motion runs at a capped rate (proposal: at most 30 frames per second, paced through the existing capped-rate wake path), only while the popup is open, never on the reading line, and stops on exit (the 3 s EXIT_MOTION_MAX cap in vo already ends a run; idle loops must still stop at once on exit).
- Add an ambient-loop helper in vo if the existing `ambient(LoopProp, Loop)` and paced wakes are not enough (for example a paced shader time uniform).
- Extend the budget tools: a per-look measurement of CPU time and GPU time per second while recording and while idle-open, with each look's defaults. Proposed budget: under 2 % of one core and under 1 ms GPU per frame at 600x300. Update the budget gate so paced idle frames are allowed and counted against this budget, not rejected.
- Report today's CPU use per look during a replayed dictation (the maintainer asked for this number).
- Update docs/MOTION-PLAN.md rule 8 and docs/REDESIGN-PLAN.md with the decision.
Files: framework crates/vo (live.rs or a new ambient helper), scripts/budget.sh, docs; popup measurement flag if needed.

Given a look with an idle loop, when the popup is open with no speech, then it draws at the capped rate and stays under the budget.
Given exit, then idle loops stop and the show ends without the "still moving" note.
